name: K2-Horizon-7B

official_org.value: IFM = 'Institute of Foundation Models' (HF org fullname; isVerified false, enterprise plan, 118 members). Same org hosts the older K2, K2-Chat, K2-Think, K2-V2, Amber, Crystal repos (former LLM360 lineage; W&B project wandb.ai/llm360/K2-Horizon-7B). Code at github.com/ifm-ai/xllm.

release_date.value: HF createdAt 2026-09-01T23:14:30Z; Artificial Analysis releaseDate 2026-09-03; main promoted to the anti-doom-loop (FTPO) checkpoint on 2026-10-01 (commit 85d46bbaf6); lastModified 2026-11-04. Blog https://ifm.ai/blog/k2/ returned HTTP 403.

license.value: Apache-2.0 (card metadata and HF license tag; no separate LICENSE file). No restrictions beyond Apache-2.0 found. Training data, code and eval code stated as fully open.

params.value: Dense. 8,999,178,240 BF16 parameters (HF safetensors metadata); '7B-core' per card, about 6.95B body plus 2 x 1.03B untied embedding/lm_head (vocab 250,624 x 4096). Active = total.

architecture.value: K2HorizonForCausalLM (model_type k2_horizon, custom_code). 36 layers, all full attention (sliding_window null, no linear/Mamba, no MoE: num_experts 0), hidden 4096, 32 Q heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, intermediate 12288 SiLU, RoPE theta 1e7, max_position_embeddings 524288, vocab 250624, BF16.

context_length.value: 524,288 tokens native (config and card; midtraining stages 3-4 at 512K). vLLM recipe default 131K baseline; vendor SWE-bench/TB2.1 at 256k.

modalities.value: Text in, text out only; template raises on non-text content parts. No vision tower.

thinking.how_to_toggle: Cannot be switched off: template has no enable_thinking and always opens <ifm|think> (high, default), <ifm|think_fast> (medium) or <ifm|think_faster> (low). vLLM: chat_template_kwargs {"reasoning_effort":"high|medium|low"} per request or --default-chat-template-kwargs; v0.33.0 parser only accepts the effort-specific end tag (open vllm#62743), so use high only. llama.cpp b12407: chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort or the OpenAI reasoning_effort field (server-common.cpp ~L1566); 'none'/--reasoning off does not disable it (k2-horizon.cpp L28-29); medium/low end-tag fallback present (fix for #30246). Ollama ifm/k2-horizon tagged 'thinking'; effort control not verified. Vendor: always high, temp 1.0, top_p 0.95, >=32,768 output tokens.

tool_calling.format: <ifm|tool_calls><ifm|tool_call>NAME <ifm|arg_key>k</ifm|arg_key><ifm|arg_value>v</ifm|arg_value></ifm|tool_call></ifm|tool_calls> (xml default; json and xml_typed via chat_template_kwargs tool_call_format). Tool results in <|ifm|im_start|>tool turns.
tool_calling.evidence: chat_template.jinja render_call_instructions/render_tool_calls_block; vLLM v0.33.0 tool_parsers/k2_horizon_tool_parser.py registered 'k2_horizon' (json/xml/xml_typed, streaming); llama.cpp b12407 common/parsers/k2-horizon.cpp. Template raises if an assistant history message lacks a thinking field, if tool parameters are not a dict, or if 'required' names a missing property. vLLM v0.33.0 forwards only the 'reasoning' key (renderers/chat_utils/chat_message.py L619-659); OpenCode v2.3.0 sends reasoning "" on every assistant message when compatibility.reasoningField is set (packages/ai/src/protocols/openai-chat.ts L568-604, L659-665). llama.cpp injects reasoning_content "" itself. Vendor BFCL v4 67.0; AA tau3-Banking 27.6.

vllm.arch_supported: Yes, native: registry.py L147 K2HorizonForCausalLM -> k2_horizon at tag v0.33.0; recipe recipes/models/IFM/K2-Horizon-7B.yaml. No vLLM config class, so --trust-remote-code required.
vllm.min_version: Present in v0.31.0 per vllm#62743; v0.33.0 confirmed
vllm.best_checkpoint: cyankiwi/K2-Horizon-7B-AWQ-INT4 (W4A16 int4 g32, 7.56 GiB) is the only vLLM checkpoint reaching 64k on 16 GB, and only with FP8 KV. Official IFM/K2-Horizon-7B-FP8 (10.29 GiB) tops out near 46k (util 0.92) or 53k (util 0.95) with FP8 KV. Both uploaded before the 2026-10-01 FTPO promotion, so pre-FTPO weights (inferred from dates; FP8 card shows SWE-V 70.6 / TB2.1 39.1).
vllm.quant_on_sm120: FP8 block 128x128 / 1x128 dynamic: v0.33.0 ships scaled_mm_blockwise_sm120_fp8.cu (CUTLASS sm_120 path exists; selection inferred). AWQ-INT4 W4A16: Marlin (inferred). FP8 KV needs --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN (#61239).
vllm.serve_command: docker run --rm --device nvidia.com/gpu=all --ipc=host --memory 24g -p 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 -v $HOME/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0 cyankiwi/K2-Horizon-7B-AWQ-INT4 --trust-remote-code --chat-template-content-format string --max-model-len 65536 --max-num-seqs 1 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN --reasoning-parser k2_horizon --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser k2_horizon --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"reasoning_effort":"high","tool_call_format":"xml"}'
vllm.known_issues: vllm#62743 OPEN: medium/low effort leaks reasoning/content. Template 400s on assistant messages without 'reasoning' (set OpenCode reasoningField 'reasoning'). Template rejects tool schemas with required names missing from properties. Unverified whether the parser sees reasoning_effort from --default-chat-template-kwargs. BF16 needs about 22 GB per recipe.

llamacpp.tool_calling_note: Dedicated PEG parser for xml and json; injects empty reasoning_content into history so OpenCode works without extra config; medium/low end-tag fallback at b12407. Reasoning in reasoning_content. Thinking cannot be disabled. Not run here.

sampling: Vendor: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, reasoning_effort high, at least 32,768 output tokens (card Best Practices, vLLM recipe). generation_config sets only eos [1, 250019]. No Unsloth repo or guide found.
speed_notes: Inferred decode ceilings (bytes per token excluding input-embedding table, 896 GB/s): llama.cpp Q8_0 about 8.5 GB -> about 105 tok/s ceiling, realistic 65-80; Q4_K_M about 5.2 GB -> about 170 ceiling, realistic 100-120. vLLM FP8 about 9.0 GB -> about 100 ceiling; AWQ-INT4 about 6.1 GB -> about 145 ceiling. KV reads add up to 4.8 GB/token at 64k with q8_0/FP8 KV, roughly halving decode near full context. Always-on high-effort thinking (vendor mean 3.2k tokens IFEval, 15.6k LiveCodeBench) makes turns long. Nothing measured here.

opencode_fit.recommended_checkpoint: bartowski/K2-Horizon-7B-GGUF Q8_0 (8.92 GiB), all on GPU
opencode_fit.caveats: Independent AA TB2.1 44.2 and tau3 27.6 match Qwen3.6-35B-A3B at 7B dense fully in VRAM, so worth measuring. But: thinking always on and vendor wants 32k output tokens (lower OpenCode limit.output to about 16k at 64k context); vLLM is weak on 16 GB (BF16 no fit, official FP8 max about 46-53k, only community AWQ-INT4 plus FP8 KV reaches 64k, both pre-FTPO weights; vllm#62743 breaks medium/low); OpenCode on vLLM needs compatibility.reasoningField 'reasoning' or the template errors; strict template rejects malformed tool schemas; SWE-V 72.4 unconfirmed independently; IFM org not HF-verified.
